entries.title: Why a Visa D ?
entries.body:
Working abroad is more than obtaining a visa—it's the beginning of a new chapter in life. This series documents my brother's complete journey of applying for an Austrian Visa D as an seasonal worker. From the very first idea of working in Austria to collecting documents, attending appointments, overcoming unexpected challenges, and finally preparing for departure, every step has been recorded.

My goal is to provide an honest and detailed account of the entire process so that future workers and job-seekers and their families can better understand what to expect. I hope my experience will serve as both a practical guide and a source of encouragement for others who dream of studying in Austria.

Why Visa D ?

See, there are two types of Visa: Visa C and Visa D. Visa C is for those who want to reside in Austria for 90 days. Visa D is for those who want to reside in Austria for 91 days to 180 days. Those who have job/residence for more than 3 months should apply for Visa D (Visum D). In India, Visas C and D can be applied via VFS Global Centre which is found in major cities like Pune, Delhi, Mumbai, etc.

Click Here: https://visa.vfsglobal.com/ind/en/aut/

How to Start?
1. Ensure that your passport is ready. If not, please apply for new passport, and if expired, apply for re-issue of passport.

Click Here: https://www.passportindia.gov.in/psp

Check that at least two pages are blank and that passport is not more than 10 years older. When taking Xerox or Blank-and-White copies, it must include bio-data page, previous stamps from other countries (if any), family details, and last two pages. It's also necessary to take copies of old passport and new passport together.


Ensure to have Aadhar Card
entries.callout: Disclaimer: The information and procedures shared in this guide are based on my personal experience and the rules applicable at the time of my application. Schengen visa requirements, Austrian immigration policies, and application procedures may change, so always verify the latest information with the relevant embassy, consulate, or official government sources before applying.
